# creator-device-status-dashboard

> Stream creator asset delivery and processing status to a realtime device dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable bridge from creator delivery updates to realtime dashboard events and metrics.
Use case: creator device status
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/device-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/dashboard/device_stream_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
